description: Test suite for 'credits' utility functions and credit normalization logic in the project. It tests 'getCreditsPerUsd', 'usdToCredits', and the presence of credits fields in project and user objects.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Retrieves the number of credits per USD, defaulting to 20000 if environment variable is unset.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount into credits based on the current credits per USD rate, handling invalid inputs gracefully.
